overview: We make your Shopify stock numbers something you can trust. faq: Can you sync stock with my supplier automatically?

We can set up a scheduled file or an inventory app that your supplier supports, and you pay the app yourself. If the supplier offers no feed, we build a simple spreadsheet routine you can run in minutes.
Will you count my physical stock?
No, we work from the counts you send us or from your warehouse report. We make sure Shopify matches them and flag any numbers that look wrong, such as negative stock or a count that never moves.
What happens to products that sell out?
We set the rule you choose: hide them, keep them visible as sold out, or let customers join a back-in-stock list. Overselling settings are checked per product so you do not sell what you cannot ship.
Does it work with POS or several locations?
Yes. Shopify locations, including POS, can be set up. The Premium package covers up to three locations, and we can quote more if your stock sits in more places than that.
